title: mentha pulegium var. exigua
intro: Mentha pulegium var. exigua, commonly known as Pennyroyal, is a lesser-known variety of the Pennyroyal plant, which is a type of mint native to Europe and the Mediterranean region. It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine to treat a variety of health issues, including digestive problems, headaches, and menstrual cramps, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pennyroyal include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as an antiseptic, which is attributed to its bioactive constituents such as menthone, pulegone, and limonene. These constituents have been found to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making Pennyroyal a valuable plant in natural medicine.
